nodes.text: Quiet on the planks. Voss. The water listens, and it gossips.

choices.text: What's out past the last post?

nodes.text: Eleven thousand fish, give or take, since I first held a rod. I remember nine of them. That ratio is correct and I'll thank you not to improve it.
Something past the last post takes hooks and leaves the line. Clean bite, no fight, gone. Twenty years now. A short wait is an hour out here. That one has been a long wait.
Rods that work. Fish that did.
Mind the planks. Wet wood keeps score.
